name: Loosid
one_liner: Loosid is a sobriety app combining a sober-day counter with a recovery community, events, chats and sober dating.
best_for: People in recovery who want an online sober community and group chats
Finding sober events and meetings near you
not_for: Anyone who may need medical help to stop drinking or using safely (withdrawal can be dangerous)
People looking for professional treatment or counseling
Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
short_description: A free sobriety app with a sober-day counter, a recovery community, group chats, events and listings of meetings and treatment centers.
long_description: Loosid is a free sobriety app from Loosid App LLC. You track sober days and milestones, post and chat with other people in recovery, find sober events, read recovery stories, and look up AA meetings and treatment centers. Loosid's FAQ describes a paid premium tier (about $20/month) that adds features such as SAM, an AI recovery companion, and says financial assistance is available. Sober dating is offered in a separate Loosid dating app. Loosid is peer support and self-help, not treatment, and no published study of the app was found.
patient_summary: You download the app, create an account, and track your sober days while connecting with other people in recovery through posts, group chats and events. It also lists meetings and treatment centers. The core app is free; a premium tier costs about $20/month.

pricing.notes: Core app is free. Loosid's FAQ lists a premium subscription at $20/month (including the SAM AI recovery companion) and says financial assistance and scholarships are offered. Third-party sites quote other prices; confirm in the app.

privacy.notes: Policy says personal information is not sold or shared for direct marketing, but it lets third parties collect behavioral tracking data and doesn't honor Do Not Track; you can delete your account. No regulatory action found.

faqs.a: Free; Sober Plus $12.99/month. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Loosid before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Loosid replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Loosid is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Loosid is available on iPhone and Android.
Sobriety counter; Community posts and chats; Events and meetups; Recovery stories; Meeting and treatment-center lists.
